mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (below 2.0%) compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL inflation rate exceeding 0.3% signals accelerating inflation, prompting central bank rate hikes that compress equity valuations and drive negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL monthly change exceeds 0.3% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4.0% and the federal funds rate is below 2.0%, the economy is in an overheating phase, leading to imminent monetary tightening that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and FEDFUNDS < 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, when housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 and industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105, the economy shows signs of overheating and supply constraints, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 1300 and INDPRO < 105 (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is rising (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may accelerate inflation and prompt monetary tightening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.0%, it indicates a slowing economy with restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100 and FEDFUNDS > 2.0% (t-test p>0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime, when retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 500000 and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300, the economy shows robust consumer and housing activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 500000 and HOUST > 1300 (t-test p>0.05 for positive returns).
